annotations.text:
THREE TIERS, not two walls of numbers.
v1 stacks 6 lens tiles + 5 tab metrics = 11 numbers before any content.
1. Attention row - filtered entry points, primary.
2. Tab strip - carries its own count inline (v1 already does this at the pill level).
3. Tab metric strip - compact, secondary, no cards.

THE PLACE TAB IS GONE, 2026-09-15.
This strip carried eight tabs including Place. The product has seven and never had Place: verified against DS_TABS and TAB_LABELS in web/index.html at origin/main.
The map became a persistent dock rail instead (smartcity-map-dock, approved, dispatched G-128) and _design/smartcity-place-tab is the option not taken.
A design going to a city for approval may not show a tab we ruled against building.

THE SECOND AXIS TAKES ITS SHAPE FROM THE DATA.
Every operational tab carries a queue plus a second dimension, and the three second dimensions are not the same kind of thing:
  Inspections - PAIRED. Result is defined for every record, meaningful for a subset. Four peer classes.
  Code enforcement - ORDERED. An escalation ladder; rung 3 is further along than rung 2. Rungs.
  Licences - CONTINUOUS. Expiry is an integer on every record; bands are derived from it. Bands with printed boundaries.
Drawing all three as tiles would assert they are the same shape. They are not, and the difference is what staff read.

EVERY ROW ON PAGE ONE READS "NOT INSPECTED". That is correct, not a defect.
The queue sorts by severity, so page one is the unresolved work and none of it has been inspected yet. "Not inspected" is a declared result value carrying a basis, never an empty cell, and it is MEASURED rather than derived by subtracting the other three - a record matching no declared result would otherwise be absorbed into it and read as normal.
Three rows read "Not scheduled". An unscheduled inspection has no day and none is invented; a zero would render as "today", which is a claim.

NOBODY IS NAMED ON A PUBLISHED WORKLOAD RANKING.
This strip named five people until 2026-09-15. Those strings appear nowhere in doc_repo outside gen.mjs and nowhere in smartcity-dashboards, so they were invented or transcribed from a capture not in this repo. Invented staff on a performance rank is fabrication; real staff on one is not ours to publish to their employer.
The product had already ruled it: "the dimension survives, the person does not" (src/domains/inspections.mjs). Opaque refs, and the load table is still buildable.

ONE TABLE TREATMENT for every operational list.
v1 uses a real table on Code enforcement (the most scannable view in the app) and stacked rich rows everywhere else (walls of text). The table wins and every tab inherits it.

STATUS IS THE BADGE; THE RUNG IS A SECOND CHANNEL.
One element never carries both, the same rule the lens applies to department. The rung renders as "3 of 4 - Final notice" because the number is data on the record, not the row's position in a list: a rung inserted later must not silently renumber the ones above it.
NO FIGURE OF MONEY APPEARS ANYWHERE ON THIS TAB and the basis says so. A city ladder ends in an assessed figure; no ledger has been read.

PII: the free-text description is NOT a list column.
v1 work-order descriptions carry citizen names and personal phone numbers ("DEBORAH MOORE, PH#737-762-6252"). Structured columns - type, place, department - are more scannable AND stop rendering PII into a scannable list.
Code enforcement is the highest-PII surface here: a complaint names a neighbour. The complainant is not a field on the record at all.
This is a design decision, NOT a control. The fields still need a real gate.

THE ONE TAB WITH NO LOAD DIMENSION, AND IT SAYS SO.
A licence is held by a business; it is not assigned to a member of staff. The other three operational tabs share one load component, and this tab omitting it is a property of the record rather than a gap - so the absence is stated where the strip would have been, instead of the tab quietly looking different.
The holder is opaque for the reason the inspector is: inventing plausible business names would put fabricated companies on a surface a city reads.

THESE THREE RENDER THE DEMO PACK, DELIBERATELY.
Pipeline and Work orders show a granted MyGov read. These three show the same lens BEFORE a source is granted, which is what Bastrop staff see on day one.
It is also the only mode where every value is checkable against the domain source. And it is the honest answer to "is any of this real": the fixture place vocabulary is Template Commons, Fixture Ridge, Example Crossing, Sample Bend, Placeholder Heights, Specimen Yard.
The demo data announces itself as demo data, in the data.

ONE LOAD PATTERN, not three panels.
Inspector load, Manager load and Officer load are the same shape: work distributed across people. One collapsible strip, same component, on every tab with assignable work.
Service performance becomes a VIEW MODE (List / Map / Performance), not a stray button.

Plan review is a TAB here and a separate scope.
Operator ruling 2026-09-14. It is named in the strip so staff can find it, and it is designed in its own three folders - plan-review, plan-review-reasoner, plan-review-departments.
